name: Case-Study Proof Auto-Assembler

parameters.content:
## Case-Study Proof Auto-Assembler

### Internal Protomated tool — not a law firm template

Unlike everything else in this catalog, this workflow runs on **Protomated's own** Salesmate CRM, not a client's system. It exists because publishing a case study today means a partner blocking time for interviews, data-pulling, and copywriting weeks after a Build closes — so it never gets prioritized. This automates the assembly, but never the publish decision.

### How it works

**A. Draft assembly (top row)** — Fires when a Build/Deep Assessment deal moves to Closed Won in Salesmate. Looks up the client's before/after metrics (response time, no-show rate, hours saved) from a manually-maintained results tracker, drafts a one-pager, logs it to a review ledger, and emails Dele plus the client contact for review and sign-off. If metrics haven't been entered yet, it tells Dele that instead of drafting anything.

**B. Stale review reminder (bottom row)** — Runs daily, independently. Nudges Dele about any draft that's sat in 'pending review' past a configurable number of days, so a drafted case study doesn't quietly die in an inbox.

**This never publishes anything on its own.** It only ever produces a DRAFT and routes it for two human approvals — Dele's, and the client's own sign-off plus quote. Nothing goes out the door without both. It only aggregates operational metrics the client has already agreed can be shared (ABA Op. 512 doesn't even apply here — this is Protomated's own marketing operations, not legal work — but the human sign-off gate exists regardless because it's still someone else's business results).

### Setup steps

- [ ] Set up the Bar-Compliance Guardrail (NTC-33) first — the client-facing sign-off request goes through it.
- [ ] Create a Salesmate automation rule that fires a webhook to this workflow's URL when a deal in the Build or Deep Assessment pipeline moves to Closed Won.
- [ ] Create a Google Sheet with a 'Results Tracker' tab (manually filled in by the team during the engagement) and a 'Case Studies' tab (this workflow's own review ledger) — see the deploy guide for exact columns.
- [ ] Add a Header Auth credential for the Salesmate API token.
- [ ] Set the required n8n Variables: DELE_EMAIL, FIRM_FROM_EMAIL, GUARDRAIL_WORKFLOW_ID, RESULTS_TRACKER_SHEET_ID, CASE_STUDY_LEDGER_SHEET_ID.
- [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Customization

The Salesmate response shapes here are built from Salesmate's documented v4 API and the sample payloads already used elsewhere in Protomated's own automations — confirm the exact field names against a real webhook delivery on first live test and adjust 'Parse Closed Won Deal Webhook' if anything differs.

## Draft the case study and route it for approval

Fires when a deal closes won. Pulls the client's before/after metrics, drafts a one-pager, logs it for review, and emails Dele and the client for sign-off — never publishes anything itself.

## Stale review reminder — a second, independent daily branch

Nudges Dele about any draft that's sat in 'pending review' too long, so a drafted case study doesn't quietly die in an inbox.

nodes.name: When Deal Moves To Closed Won
nodes.notes: Wire this to a Salesmate automation rule: 'When a deal's stage changes to Closed Won' -> 'Call webhook' -> this URL. Scope the Salesmate rule to the Build and Deep Assessment pipelines if possible; this workflow double-checks that anyway.

nodes.name: Parse Closed Won Deal Webhook
nodes.notes: Confirms this is really a Closed Won deal in the Build or Deep Assessment pipeline. Adjust CASE_STUDY_PIPELINES if Salesmate's pipeline names differ from what's configured here.

nodes.name: Is Valid Case Study Deal
nodes.notes: True continues to draft the case study; false means this stage change wasn't a Build/Deep Assessment Closed Won deal and gets a quick acknowledgment instead.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'ignored', reason: 'not a Build/Deep Assessment deal closing won' } }}

nodes.name: Respond Not A Case Study Deal
nodes.notes: Acknowledges the webhook so Salesmate doesn't retry — this event just isn't relevant to case studies.

nodes.name: Fetch Full Deal Details From Salesmate
nodes.notes: The webhook payload is lean, so this re-fetches the full deal record -- client/company name, deal value, and the primary contact ID -- using a Header Auth credential holding the Salesmate API token.

nodes.name: Fetch Primary Contact From Salesmate
nodes.notes: The deal record only carries the contact's ID, not their email -- this looks up the actual client contact who needs to review and sign off.

nodes.name: Read Client Results Tracker
nodes.notes: Reads the manually-maintained sheet where the team logs each client's before/after metrics during the engagement. Columns: deal_id, client_name, response_time_before_hours, response_time_after_hours, no_show_rate_before_pct, no_show_rate_after_pct, hours_saved_per_week.

nodes.name: Find Matching Results Entry
nodes.notes: Looks up this deal's row in the results tracker by deal_id. Missing numeric fields come through as null rather than 0, so the drafting step can tell 'not entered' apart from 'genuinely zero.'

nodes.name: If Results Entry Found
nodes.notes: True means the team has already logged before/after metrics for this deal and drafting can proceed; false means Dele needs to fill in the Results Tracker first.

nodes.name: Build Missing Metrics Notice Email
nodes.notes: Tells Dele the metrics are missing instead of silently doing nothing -- this deal will need the sheet filled in and this branch re-run manually (there's no automatic retry, since there's nothing new to poll for).

nodes.name: Notify Dele Metrics Not Yet Logged
nodes.notes: A plain heads-up, not an error — this is the normal state until someone fills in the Results Tracker row for this deal.

nodes.name: Respond Metrics Not Yet Logged
nodes.notes: Acknowledges the webhook so Salesmate doesn't retry — the deal was valid, there's just nothing to draft from yet.

nodes.name: Compute Case Study Headline Stat
nodes.notes: Whichever metric improved the most becomes the headline. Any metric that's null (not entered) is simply left out of consideration rather than showing as a false '0% improvement.'

nodes.name: Draft Case Study One-Pager
nodes.notes: The actual draft content. This is a starting point for Dele to polish, not finished copy — no case study goes out without a human rewrite pass and the client's own quote.

nodes.name: Log Draft Case Study For Review
nodes.notes: Every draft gets one row here — status starts 'pending_review' and only ever changes by someone editing the sheet directly once Dele and the client have both weighed in; this template has no separate approval webhook. Column headers must match exactly, same silent-drop risk as every other Sheets ledger in this catalog.

nodes.name: Build Internal Review Request Email
nodes.notes: This is Dele's 'review task' — an email with the full draft, since this catalog has no established task-management integration to open a real task in.

nodes.name: Log Review Request For Compliance Audit
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit logging only — Dele is internal, not on any opt-out list, so the guardrail's approval result is deliberately ignored here, same internal-notification pattern used throughout this catalog.

nodes.name: Send Review Request To Dele
nodes.notes: The actual email to Dele with the full draft and a pointer to the sheet row — configure the SMTP credential on this node.

nodes.name: Build Client Sign-Off Request Email
nodes.notes: This goes to an actual outside person — the client's own contact — so unlike the internal email to Dele, it goes through the full guardrail check (opt-out respected, disclaimer applied) rather than being fire-and-forget.

nodes.name: Check Compliance Before Requesting Sign-Off
nodes.notes: Runs the client contact through the Bar-Compliance Guardrail (NTC-33) before anything sends — opt-out respected, required disclaimer appended, send logged, same as every other client-facing send in this catalog.

nodes.name: If Sign-Off Request Approved
nodes.notes: Mirrors the guardrail's approved/opted-out result for the client contact — true sends the sign-off request, false means they've opted out of firm emails and it's suppressed.

nodes.name: Send Client Sign-Off Request Email
nodes.notes: The actual email to the client's contact asking for review, approval, and a quote — configure the SMTP credential on this node.

nodes.name: Respond Case Study Drafted
nodes.notes: Final success acknowledgment for the webhook — the draft is logged, Dele's been notified, and the client sign-off request went out.

nodes.name: Skip — Client Opted Out Of Firm Emails
nodes.notes: The draft is still logged and Dele still gets the review request — only the client-facing sign-off request is suppressed, exactly like an opt-out anywhere else in this catalog.

nodes.name: Respond Sign-Off Skipped
nodes.notes: Final acknowledgment for the case where the client has opted out — the draft still exists and Dele still knows, but no sign-off request was sent to the client.

nodes.name: Check For Stale Case Study Reviews Daily
nodes.notes: Runs daily, 9am by default — adjust the cron expression if a different time suits.

nodes.name: Read Case Study Review Ledger
nodes.notes: Reads every row logged by the main branch's 'Log Draft Case Study For Review' step, regardless of status.

nodes.name: Filter Entries Still Pending Review
nodes.notes: Only rows still awaiting a decision matter here — anything already published, rejected, or otherwise resolved is skipped.

nodes.name: Compute Days Pending And Check If Reminder Needed
nodes.notes: STALE_REVIEW_DAYS controls how long a draft can sit before Dele gets nudged — defaults to 5.

nodes.name: Filter Entries Needing A Reminder
nodes.notes: Only entries that have actually crossed STALE_REVIEW_DAYS make it through to an actual reminder email.

nodes.name: Build Stale Review Reminder Email
nodes.notes: A plain nudge naming the client and how many days it's been sitting, so Dele can jump straight to the sheet row.

nodes.name: Send Stale Review Reminder Email
nodes.notes: Sends the nudge to Dele — same SMTP credential as the rest of this workflow.

Major Estate Planning — 40% faster response time

main.node: Fetch Full Deal Details From Salesmate
Respond Not A Case Study Deal
